newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-DAVIS SUFFERS HEAVY SECOND-ROUND DEFEAT.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-DAVIS SUFFERS HEAVY SECOND-ROUND DEFEAT.

text.p: Six-times title winner Steve Davis suffered his biggest defeat in the world snooker championship for 15 years on Sunday.
Britain's Davis was beaten 13-3 by Ken Doherty of Ireland in the second round.
Davis's previous heaviest world championship defeat was in the first round 15 years ago when he lost 10-1 to compatriot Tony Knowles.
Doherty, the world number seven, led 6-2 overnight and rattled off six frames in a row to leave the former world champion facing an immense task in the best-of-25-frames match.
Although Davis briefly staved off the inevitable, Doherty took the final scheduled frame of the night on the black, having played some exhibition snooker.
